text:
Arjun: Heads-up — I ran a sim for transient GPU steering during region churn. Summary: enterprise routes hit ~3x p99 latency in cold cross-region failover. Need to adjust routing + variant policy.

Mia: Can you paste the sim config and the condensed numbers?

Arjun: Pasted:```
route.policy: tiered-steering
prefer: reserved-region
warm-standby: enabled
fallbacks:
  - type: regional-warm
  - type: cross-region-spot
  - type: model-variant-quantized
max_fanout: 4
min_variant_window_s: 30
per_tenant_cost_cap_usd: 0.12
```

Elaine: Why the 3x spike? network RTT or KV cache misses?

Arjun: Mostly KV cache miss + cold KV + variant switch penalty + extra retries from fanout. Example log snippet:```
[2026-03-15T16:03:12Z] request id=abc123 route=enterprise/us-west -> spilled to us-east-spot; kv_miss=true; variant_switch=quantized-v2; latency=980ms
[2026-03-15T16:03:12Z] request id=def456 route=enterprise/us-west -> reserved warm; kv_hit=false; p99=1.1s
```

Noah: Proposal: two-lane fallback behavior
1) regional warm-standby (same region, pinned warm GPUs but lower priority capacity)
2) cross-region spot as tertiary with aggressive streaming and token-rate-limits
Also: stop full-fanout for requests under value_threshold.

Mia: Add per-tenant "quantize-only-after-ttl" so we don't flip enterprise customers straight to quantized models. TTL=60s sounds sane.

SRE-bot: Simulation alert: test-run 1773001112 -> eviction_rate=15% => tertiary_fallback_hit=8%, avg_degraded_latency=720ms.

Elaine: Also add a guard to prevent oscillation: min_variant_window_s=30 and a max_variant_switches_per_min=2.

Arjun: I'll author a canary policy: canary_routes = [50 enterprise users in us-west]; duration=30m; metrics: variant_switch_rate, degraded_p99, cross_region_volume. Pseudo-config to gate fanout by cost and value:```
policy.gating:
  fanout: if request.value_score >= 0.6 and cost_so_far < per_tenant_cost_cap_usd
  cross_region: allow_if regional_capacity < 0.7 and request.priority >= enterprise
```

Noah: Metric names to add to dashboards: variant_switch_rate, cross_region_fanout_rate, avg_latency_degraded, cost_per_request_degraded.

Mia: I'll wire up dashboard + alerts: variant_switch_rate > 0.5/min over 5m, avg_latency_degraded > 800ms for enterprise routes => pager.

Arjun: Plan: push config to canary, monitor for 30m, abort if degraded_p99 increases > 15% vs baseline. Will create PR and tag @Elaine @Noah for review.

Elaine: SGTM. Also drop a short note in runbook about manual escalation and the warm-standby budget.

Noah: I'll follow up with cost sensitivity curve so finance can see projected spot savings vs SLA risk.
